description: This file defines the TinyMCE plugin 'noneditable', which manages non-editable elements within the TinyMCE rich text editor, including plugin info, initialization, event handling, content cleanup, and DOM manipulation.

classes.name: TinyMCE_NonEditablePlugin
classes.description: Defines the 'noneditable' plugin for TinyMCE, providing info, initialization, event handling, and content cleanup functionalities.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Returns plugin information such as name, author, URL, and version.

methods.name: initInstance
methods.description: Initializes plugin instance, imports CSS, and adjusts settings for IE5.0.

methods.name: handleEvent
methods.description: Handles editor events, particularly selection movement.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up content for different event types, managing editable/non-editable classes and attributes.

methods.name: _moveSelection
methods.description: Adjusts selection range to respect non-editable regions in Gecko browsers.

methods.name: _setEditable
methods.description: Sets the contenteditable attribute and class for an element based on desired editable state.
